content:
nik: quick heads-up — onboarding calypso-lite-3b (hf -> onnx -> runtime) hit a weird regression after our int4 recipe. throughput fine, but summarization outputs become terse and sometimes inject odd punctuation. not a full failure but quality drop is visible in evals. anyone free to triage?

pilar: can you paste the quant command and the eval numbers?

eval-bot: smoke-run (summ-suite-v3): fp16 ROUGE-1=0.436 ROUGE-L=0.371 avg_len=84; int4 ROUGE-1=0.312 ROUGE-L=0.254 avg_len=48; ppl_long=2.1 -> 3.4. latency +2% on our runtime.

samir: two usual suspects: (1) tokenizer normalization/merging changed ids, (2) rotary/freq paramization mismatch. also check whether we accidentally applied per-head folding or a global scale override during export.

ik: export command used: ```python convert.py --model calypso-lite-3b --from hf --to onnx --quant int4 --rotary-mode global --preserve-token-ids false --bpe-merge auto``` no warnings in logs.

pilar: ah `--preserve-token-ids false` stands out. that can rebase special tokens. do a simple encode diff: run HF tokenizer vs converted tokenizer on a set of control strings including EOS/BOS/sentinels and a sampled 200 common phrases.\

samir: also check model config: calypso has a weird `rotary_base: 10000` but some exports expect 4096 or per_head_freq. mismatch there makes the sin/cos features alias at different strides and quant amplifies aliasing.

ik: ran the encode diff — found several special tokens remapped (e.g., "</s>" moved from id 2 -> 50260 and an extra alias for "<pad>" inserted). also saw NFKC normalization toggled by the converter when `bpe-merge auto` ran; that collapsed some combining diacritics and shifted downstream ids.

pilar: NFKC toggles are subtle; they change how diacritics are represented which can shift many subword merges and cause a block shift for ids >= vocab_cutoff. That plus special token rebinding can push sentinel/id-threshold collisions at runtime.

samir: for the rotary bit: look at the exported onnx initializers. if `rotary_freq` or `inv_freq` arrays are scaled incorrectly (global vs per-head), you get phase drift as context grows. quantized kernels (int4) have reduced precision for trig tables so even a small scale error becomes visible.

ik: quick experiment: re-export with `--preserve-token-ids true --rotary-mode per_head --rotary-base 4096` and no bpe-merge. re-run 20 eval samples.

eval-bot: micro-run after re-export: int4 ROUGE-1=0.389 ROUGE-L=0.343 avg_len=77 ppl_long=2.25. still slightly behind fp16 but much closer.

pilar: good sign — token id preservation recovered most of length and coherence. suggest we add two guards: (A) require `preserve-token-ids` for any autopacker unless explicit mapping manifest is provided, (B) auto-detect `rotary_base` mismatch by comparing onnx `inv_freq` distribution to HF config and warn if L2 norm diff > threshold.

samir: add a small CI test that encodes 256 samples and diffs ids, plus a trig-table check for rotary export. we should also simulate quant noise on the trig tables (small gaussian) to see sensitivity and pick a safe default `rotary_base` fallback per family.

ik: i'll open PR 3142 with converter defaults changed (preserve ids on by default), a `tokenizer_manifest.json` included next to artifacts listing special token -> id, and the rotary check CI. i'll also attach the repro notebook to the PR: s3://redwood-temp/calypso/encode_diff_and_trig_noise.ipynb

pilar: can we also add a runtime-side defensive check that maps known special-token strings to ids by name if the id looks suspicious (e.g., >=50256)? feature-flag it so we don't mask converter bugs silently.

samir: agreed. runtime fallback is useful during rollout but should log loudly and emit a one-time onboarding alert. also add a quant-sim test that measures argmax propensity for EOS under quantized logits to catch early-stop spikes.

ik: ok plan: 1) revert `bpe-merge` auto for calypso family, 2) default preserve-token-ids=true, 3) add tokenizer_manifest and encode-diff CI, 4) add rotary trig-table sanity check + per-head export, 5) runtime supervised fallback for special tokens behind a flag. i'll tag @harper for runtime review in PR.

harper: will review runtime change. add a metric event when fallback triggers so onboarding dashboards pick it up.

ik: thanks all — reproducer artifacts (hf export, onnx int4, encode diffs, eval logs) uploaded to s3://redwood-temp/calypso/onboard_artifacts/. leaving a TODO in the onboard issue RW-ONB-451. :white_check_mark:
